parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of plastic, circular in shape, and serves as the structural boundary of the clock.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all internal components such as the surface, hands, and mechanism in place, providing protection and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum, slender and elongated.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock’s center to indicate minutes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, shorter and thicker than the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock’s center to indicate hours.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slowly around the central axis, completing one revolution every 12 hours.

parts.name: Surface (Dial Face)
parts.Basic_description: This is the front surface or dial face of the clock, made of glass, flat and transparent.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the clock hands and internal components while allowing visibility of the time markings.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during operation.
